name: Business Banking App — Design System
organization: A major Israeli bank (client, via Zemingo)
context: A client engagement at Zemingo for one of Israel's major banks (name withheld — confidential client work): the design system for the bank's business-banking app. The client is never named publicly; the agent says 'a major Israeli bank'.
summary: The design system for a major Israeli bank's business-banking app, built by Boaz's design team at Zemingo and delivered. An atomic library — colors and type through text fields, tables, filters, date pickers, cards, modals and system pages — with dedicated accessibility tracks and a Transitions layer that specifies micro-interaction behavior. The showcase piece is a marketing clip designed with AI from the app's store screens, and an interactive prototype of the cancel-instruction flow whose screens are 1:1 exports of the Figma frames, wired from the authored prototype graph — the clip's CTA launches it.

evidence.label: Figma design-system file (client confidential)
evidence.notes: The full design system: atomic pages (atoms/molecules/organisms), accessibility update tracks, and a Transitions page (~286 nodes) of micro-interaction specs the prototypes were built from. Held by the owner; not linked because the client is confidential. All data in the file is placeholder.

evidence.label: Owner-confirmed role, team, status and presentation rule (2026-09-07)

artifacts.label: אב־טיפוס אינטראקטיבי
artifacts.description: The cancel-instruction flow, playable: the screens are 1:1 exports of the Figma frames, and every hotspot, transition (move-in, move-out, slide-out, dissolve) and timed step is read from the authored prototype graph. artifacts.description: An auto-playing marketing clip designed from the app's store screens — six scenes with cinematic transitions, looping. Click skips ahead.

conversation_hooks.agent_response_goal: Use as the flagship design-system evidence: a full atomic library for a major Israeli bank's business app — atoms through organisms, accessibility tracks, and a Transitions layer that specifies behavior, not just looks. Never name the bank. Show the marketing clip; it is built from the app's own store screens.

Tell the workflow story: the design system's files become working artifacts with AI — the marketing clip was designed from the store screens, and the interactive prototype's screens are 1:1 Figma exports wired from the authored prototype graph (hotspots, transitions, timers), so what you interact with IS the design. Show the prototype and let the visitor click through the flow. Never name the bank.

presentation.short_pitch: A full design system for a major Israeli bank's business app, led by Boaz at Zemingo — with an AI-crafted marketing clip and a pixel-exact interactive prototype.
presentation.long_pitch: A design system for a major Israeli bank's business-banking app, built by the Zemingo design team Boaz leads and delivered: an atomic library from tokens to system pages, accessibility tracks, and a Transitions layer specifying micro-interaction behavior. Two AI-built showcases sit on top: a marketing clip designed from the app's store screens, and an interactive prototype of the cancel-instruction flow whose screens are 1:1 exports of the Figma frames with the authored hotspots, transitions and timers — design accuracy is guaranteed because the design itself is what runs.

I can also walk through how the design system is structured, from tokens to organisms.
